summary: A Network Host Status report from Ellen Westheimer of BBN covering March 27 to April 7, 1972. During this time the Ames PDP-10 acting as front end to the Illiac became a server, though not for general use for months. A terminal IMP was installed at the University of Southern California on March 29. It updates RFC 326.

eli5.summary: This is like a school attendance sheet for the early internet. Someone wrote down which big computers were switched on and ready to help, and which ones were not, so people knew where to go.
